title: Industrial Designer 1
note: Consumer electronics and wearables at Garmin HQ; GPA 3.0+ expected.

facts.summary: Entry-level ID role designing wearables, cycling, outdoor and marine devices.
facts.duties: Explores design options, models in SolidWorks and OnShape, and builds appearance models with the prototype shop.
facts.requirements: ID or product design degree, strong hand sketching, GPA 3.0 or higher.
facts.apply: Apply through Garmin's iCIMS link on the careers page.
